title: Light gray looks good, fabric is soft, sewing is like a child sewed these.
text:
Light gray looks good, fabric is soft, sewing is like a child sewed these.. I ordered this in a queen size in the light gray for my sons bed.
The gray is a nice color. The sheets fit well, and feel soft.
I have only washed them one time before putting them on the bed, so I do not know
If there going to pill after a few washes.

The problem I have with these linens is the sewing looks like a child sewed these!
Some of the sewing is puckered , and the pillow cases are not sewed down on the back side of the pillow case! Actually I have never seen sewing like this on linens before.

That said the price is very low. You get what you pay for.
3 stars, these are ok for a kids bed !
